title.en: Idempotence: a script and a playbook

concept.hr: Skripta pokrenuta dvaput nešto pokvari; deklarativni zadatak ne
concept.en: A script run twice breaks things; a declarative task doesn't

summary.hr: Pokreni skriptu ljuske i playbook s istim zadacima više puta: skripta dodaje isti redak i pada na mkdir, a modul dira host samo kad se stanje razlikuje.
summary.en: Run a shell script and a playbook with the same tasks several times: the script appends the same line and fails on mkdir; a module acts only on a difference.

concept.hr: mkdir pada na postojećem direktoriju, set -e zaustavlja skriptu
concept.en: mkdir fails on the existing directory and set -e stops the script

title.en: A handler only after a change

concept.hr: Skripta ponovo pokreće poslužitelj svaki put, a rukovatelj samo nakon promjene
concept.en: The script restarts the server every run, the handler only after a change
